notes.title: RaySupreme 3D Version 1.53 Software Update
notes.notes:
Hello Steam community, 

We are pleased to announce that v1.53 is now available on Steam. 
New in RaySupreme v1.53 is AutoDesk FBX export support and new Cloud Simulation, as well as bug-fixes from some reported issues.

[h1]Version 1.53 now includes:[/h1]
[list] 
[*]AutoDesk FBX Export support.
[*]New Cloud feature and improved Sky Simulation. 
[*]Background reference images are fixed.
[*]Saving and loading of UV textures for Template objects is fixed.
[*]Crash on simultaneous viewport rendering and panning/orbiting/zooming is fixed.
[*]Startup crash on Linux machines with older CPUs (Core 2 and similar not supporting SSE4) is fixed.
[*]Texture Preview Fix for Specular/Transparent Materials.
[*]The Weld and Mirror tools had some problematic default settings.
[*]Texture Node Copy / Paste was bugged, fixed.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/262650/
